title: ELV emissions-control and 2026 permitted-facility register QA controls

sources.title: End of life vehicles: appropriate measures - emissions control
End of Life Vehicles - Authorised Treatment Facilities - Public Register

facts.source_fact: Permitted ELV facilities must identify, characterise and control emissions from activities that may cause pollution.
facts.expected_handling: Require source identification before assigning an emissions-control state.

facts.source_fact: Appropriately designed enclosure can reduce pollutants including noise, dust and odour.
facts.expected_handling: Record enclosure as a control measure, not a measured emission value.

facts.source_fact: Treatment likely to cause significant pollution at sensitive receptors must be enclosed when alternative measures cannot address the risk.
facts.expected_handling: Carry receptor-risk context with enclosure requirements.

facts.source_fact: Buildings used for control must have appropriate acoustic seals where required to reduce noise and vibration emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Treat acoustic controls separately from air-emission controls.

facts.source_fact: Process emissions must be collected, extracted and directed to appropriate abatement before release.
facts.expected_handling: Require capture and abatement provenance for channelled emissions.

facts.source_fact: Operators must assess the fate and impact of substances emitted to air using Environment Agency risk-assessment guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve risk-assessment provenance alongside emissions controls.

facts.source_fact: Appropriate abatement techniques must be used for point-source air emissions or an equally effective alternative demonstrated.
facts.expected_handling: Record the selected abatement technique or equivalent-efficacy evidence.

facts.source_fact: Procedures must ensure abatement equipment is correctly operated, monitored and maintained.
facts.expected_handling: Keep operational-control evidence with abatement status.

facts.source_fact: Monitoring should demonstrate abatement effectiveness so preventative or corrective action can be taken.
facts.expected_handling: Do not equate equipment presence with demonstrated performance.

facts.source_fact: Fugitive-emission controls cover dust, mud, litter, odour, noise and vibration.
facts.expected_handling: Keep fugitive-emission categories separately traceable.

facts.source_fact: Waste pre-acceptance, acceptance and site-inspection procedures are used to identify wastes that could cause fugitive emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Carry waste-screening provenance into fugitive-risk decisions.

facts.source_fact: Identified fugitive-emission risks require appropriate risk-assessed prevention and control measures.
facts.expected_handling: Require documented risk assessment for chosen controls.

facts.source_fact: Wastes causing or likely to cause fugitive emissions should be prioritised for treatment or transfer.
facts.expected_handling: Record prioritisation as an operational response.

facts.source_fact: Where necessary, waste should be stored and handled in suitably enclosed areas or buildings to prevent fugitive emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Attach storage/handling enclosure status to fugitive-risk records.

facts.source_fact: Doors should be kept closed except when access is required where enclosure is relied upon for emissions control.
facts.expected_handling: Treat access-door management as part of operational control.

facts.source_fact: A regular maintenance programme must cover buildings, plant and equipment to prevent or minimise emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Carry maintenance status and date with control evidence.

facts.source_fact: Uncontaminated water streams should be segregated from streams requiring treatment.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve water-stream classification before treatment decisions.

facts.source_fact: Contaminated water streams should be separated according to pollutant content and treatment required.
facts.expected_handling: Avoid combining incompatible water-stream evidence.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency maintains public information on permitted authorised treatment facilities and monitors the permitted ATF system.
facts.expected_handling: Use the register as facility-status provenance, not as proof of emissions performance.

facts.source_fact: Omission from a public register extract must not automatically be interpreted as proof of non-compliance.
facts.expected_handling: Require permit-level verification before negative compliance inference.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening scope.
Attach permitted facility, activity, emission type and receptor boundary.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing different ELV operations or emissions.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach guidance and register extract dates.
Carry permit/register, risk-assessment, monitoring and maintenance provenance.
Do not convert facility controls or register status into parcel-level measured emissions.
